prompts.name: 蓝青暖橙
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand / color-only edit. Recolor the provided chosen graphic lotus / 礼 monogram for 礼林生态. Keep the EXACT silhouette, petal count, proportions, internal white character channels, small seed stroke, gaps, all curves and positions. This is a color exploration, NOT a redesign. Use multiple colors IN THE MARK ITSELF, not colored backgrounds. Preserve pure white background and every existing white negative-space cut so the name-source gesture remains clear. No new shapes, contour lines, decorative cuts, borders, text, captions, hearts, flowers, shadows, texture, 3D, glass or mockups. Show ONE large centered logo with generous margins. Palette A: FLAT THREE-COLOR petal blocking. LEFT petal and the small detached seed stroke: clean rich cobalt blue #2663AA. RIGHT petal and its lower outward sweep: fresh teal #24B6A8. UPPER central petal: warm clear orange #F28856. All three colors must be clearly visible together, with restrained saturation and a professional contemporary corporate feel. No gradient, no fourth color. Do not recolor the whole logo with a single gradient. Color logic: warm orange conveys 善心 and warmth, blue conveys 善念 and considered connection, teal conveys 善行 and growth. Keep every contour exactly as the reference.
